@graph.description: Make AI UGC ads in a few minutes from a product link, a photo, or one line. Skip the creator and the shoot, and download a realistic, high-converting ad.

mainEntity.name: Why do creator-style AI ads get attention?

acceptedAnswer.text: They open like a recommendation, so the problem and the product show up before a polished brand spot would.

mainEntity.name: What does AI UGC mean for a product ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a creator-style product ad read by an AI actor, not a review from a buyer. Start from your photo or your product page, then read the words before you download.

mainEntity.name: What does a paid plan include before the first ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A photo is 24 credits. Videos of 6, 10, 15, and 30 seconds cost 24, 40, 60, and 120 credits. You see the charge before you start.

mainEntity.name: How long does an AI UGC ad take?

acceptedAnswer.text: You stay on the page and can edit the line while the file renders, then download it when it finishes. A failed job returns the credits.

mainEntity.name: How do I make a UGC ad with an AI actor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upload a product photo or paste a page link, pick an AI actor, and read the script. Change the line if it does not fit, then generate.

mainEntity.name: Where do the AI actors for these ads come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: They come from a library of 53 adult AI actors. Pick a face that fits the buyer, then pair it with a voice from the same library.

mainEntity.name: Can I turn a product link into a UGC ad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Paste a public product page so the tool can start from the product image and the name. Add who the ad is for before you review it.

mainEntity.name: Do these AI UGC ads need a signed release?

acceptedAnswer.text: No signed release is needed for an AIVideosUGC AI actor, and the file is cleared for commercial use with no watermark. You still need rights to the product photo and to any voice sample you upload.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the ad after it is generated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Edit the script, swap the face, change the captions, and render another version. The credit charge shows before you confirm that next job.

mainEntity.name: How is a customer video different from AI UGC?

acceptedAnswer.text: A customer video is filmed by a person who bought the product. An AI actor ad uses a generated face and a line you approved. Do not present it as a review from a buyer.

mainEntity.name: Should I use an AI actor or hire a person?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use an AI actor when you need the ad without a shoot, or several versions to test. Hire a person when a real founder has to be the one on camera.

mainEntity.name: Can I make the same ad in another language?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Write the product sentence in the language you sell in, then pick a voice that matches it. Render the same offer again for the next market.

mainEntity.name: Which languages can the spoken line use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any language you can write the product sentence in. Pick a voice that matches it. The same offer can be cut for TikTok and for Meta.

mainEntity.name: Where do I get help before a promotion date?

acceptedAnswer.text: Email support@aivideosugc.com with the product page and the line you want spoken. We help you get the script right before that date.

mainEntity.name: Can an AI actor use a voice we already recorded?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. An AI actor can use a cloned voice when you have rights to the sample. Upload only audio you own or are allowed to use.

mainEntity.name: Can I post creator-style ads without hiring anyone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Start from your product photo and an AI actor, then publish the download in your ad account like any other video.

mainEntity.name: Can I make a testimonial-style ad for TikTok?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Make a vertical testimonial-style ad with an AI actor, approve the line, and download it for TikTok. Check that platform's label rules before you post.

mainEntity.name: What should a small shop look for in a UGC tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tool that shows the credit cost first and lets you approve the script. It should export 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4 with no watermark. Failed jobs return credits. You can send up to 7 reference images with a job.

paras: UGC stands for user-generated content. AI UGC adapts familiar creator formats, such as product introductions, demonstrations and unboxing videos, using AI presenters, generated visuals and scripted dialogue. For a business, it is a way to explain what a product does, who it is for and how it can be used through a short video.

Start with a product link, a photo or a written idea. In AIVideosUGC, choose a scene, prepare a product script and select an AI presenter where the format calls for one. Use your own product information to shape a video for a product launch, a social ad or a product-page introduction.

Explore the four formats below to choose how you want to introduce your product. Each format provides a different starting point for the story, from a direct product explanation to a demonstration or packaging reveal.
ugc.title: What Is AI UGC?

formats.d: Introduce your product through a script spoken by an AI presenter. Focus on the main features, intended audience and everyday uses, so viewers can understand the offer before exploring the details.
Build a short story around a customer need. Explain the relevant product feature and illustrate how it could help in that situation, using product information you can support.
Plan a short sequence around a particular use, setup step or visible feature. A focused demonstration gives shoppers context and helps them understand how the product could fit into everyday use.

Plan an opening sequence that reveals the product and highlights its packaging or visible details. Use your actual product information to shape an unboxing introduction for a new launch or social post.

more_sections.h2: Create Your Product Video from Start to Finish
more_sections.lead: Bring your product photos, key selling points and script into one workspace. Choose a scene and an AI presenter where needed, then set the supported language and video format. Adapt the message for a product launch, a feature explanation or an offer, and preview the generated result before downloading.

items.d: Upload clear product photos as visual references for generation. Decide whether to focus on the full product, its packaging or a particular detail. Compare the result with your original photos, since generated details can vary.
items.t: Use Product Photos to Guide the Video

items.d: Choose an AI presenter and review the voice profile included with that presenter. Select a supported language and write the message for the audience you want to reach, so the product introduction fits the market you are addressing.
items.t: Choose a Presenter and Supported Language

items.d: Describe the speaking style and product details you want to emphasize in your brief. Use a direct script for a feature explanation or a conversational script for a lifestyle introduction. Your instructions guide the generated performance.
items.t: Guide the Tone of the Presentation

items.d: Write an opening that makes the subject clear, explain the main product benefit, and end with the next step you want viewers to take. Update the script when product details or offers change, then generate a version for that campaign.
items.t: Adapt the Script to Each Campaign

items.d: When captions are available for the selected video, choose a caption style and review the text and timing. Captions keep product names and key points visible on screen, giving viewers another way to follow the message when browsing with sound off.
items.t: Add Captions to Support the Message

items.d: Watch the generated clips and any captions together to see how the product, dialogue and story work as a whole. Once you are satisfied with the result, download the video and prepare it for the product page or social channel you plan to use.
